assumptions: Representative target-physics state/action trajectories can be collected and synchronized.
The residual model is revalidated for the robot, firmware, load and thermal state.

confidence_rationale: Two cross-simulator benchmarks, real tracking comparisons, extensive ablations and public code support the mechanism. Confidence is capped by only two representative real quantitative motions and a 4-DoF rather than full-body real delta model.

evidence.note: Defines the delta-action alignment and compares SysID, delta dynamics, noise and fine-tuning choices.

evidence.locator: DeltaA_OpenLoop._compute_torques, DeltaA_ClosedLoop._compute_torques and PPODeltaA._rollout_step at df5320c
evidence.note: Maps the residual and policy fine-tuning mechanism to official code.

question: 怎样用少量实机轨迹改善高动态技能的仿真—实机差异？

safety_case.command_limits: Derive robot/firmware-specific joint position, velocity, torque, current, temperature and task-energy envelopes; paper jump and gain settings are not deployment limits.
safety_case.emergency_stop: Test an independent emergency stop and safe power-removal behavior before dynamic data collection.
safety_case.protective_controls: Use fall arrest or padded capture where compatible, an exclusion zone, thermal/current monitoring, inspection intervals and a dedicated safety operator.
safety_case.robot_specific_warning: The real delta model covers four G1 ankle DoFs under the reported setup; other joints, robots, firmware, payloads or wear states require recollection and review.
safety_case.staged_deployment: Validate target-dynamics replay in simulation, then low-energy supported motions, locomotion, partial dynamic skills and only then bounded agile actions with abort thresholds.

statement: 在 ASAP 报告的 G1 和跨模拟器设置中，用目标物理轨迹学习小幅 delta action、把它冻结在训练仿真中微调主策略，可比 SysID、delta dynamics 和均匀动作噪声降低长时动力学与动作跟踪误差；残差只在其采集版本/工况内有效，且论文已报告过热和两台机器人受损。
